unresolved.question: Tapping the header search bar raises the static PageHeader.SearchRequested event — what UI does the subscriber present (command palette, search overlay)?
unresolved.reason: The event handler lives outside the allowed sources; asserting a navigates-to or triggers target would be invented.

unresolved.question: Which DataContext/ViewModel supplies VersionDisplay, EnvStatus.*, DotNetDisplay, PlatformInfo, ProjectRoot, RecentsPath, and SkillsPath, and when do they populate (the '...' fallbacks suggest async load)?
unresolved.reason: Binding paths are declared but the data source is outside the allowed sources; a possible transient 'loading' presentation (fallback '...') is not asserted as a state.

unresolved.question: Are info-row (horizontal label/value) and path-field (stacked label/value) intended as one label-value component family (variants) or two independent concepts?
unresolved.reason: They share typography and label/value semantics but differ in layout; no shared source declaration exists.

unresolved.question: Open Data Folder (OS shell) and Uno Platform Documentation (external browser) leave the app — should external destinations be modeled beyond instance behavior notes?
unresolved.reason: navigates-to targets in-graph screens only; these destinations are external effects recorded as instance properties.
